No single service from Times Sq-42 St reaches 47-50 Sts-Rockefeller Ctr without a transfer, and Times Sq-42 St has no free transfer to the D/F line, so Herald Sq is the transfer point. That gives 2 stops.

FINAL ANSWER: 2
